subject: user_tx now takes an account-checked CurrentUser (a31d3f0) — rebase
body: Lead decision 200307 item 1. naadi_api.auth_db.user_tx(db, user: CurrentUser, *, deadline_s) replaces user_tx(db, user_id). It raises AccountNotChecked unless user.account_checked, which only AccountDirectory.resolve sets (i.e. the user came from AccountUser / AdminUser / get_account_user / user_limited). I switched the callers on shared: courses.py limited() now depends on get_account_user and passes the user; qbank/routes.py as_user passes the user; embeddings.query.search_local/hydrate take the CurrentUser (search_routes passes it); tests/embeddings/test_perf.py uses tests.auth.accounts.checked_user(uid) for its direct service call. If you have new user_tx callers on your branches: pass the account-checked user, and depend on get_account_user (never get_current_user) for any route that touches user data. For direct service calls in tests use tests.auth.accounts.checked_user(user_id) only for a user whose session the test really opened.
